options.opd: High-resolution CT scan of the chest

analysis: Based on the patient's history and physical examination findings of chronic cough, dyspnea, productive sputum with streaks of blood, diminished lung sounds, and wheezes, the most appropriate test to confirm the diagnosis would be a high-resolution CT scan of the chest to evaluate for possible underlying lung pathology such as bronchiectasis, interstitial lung disease, or lung cancer.
